tactics.name: Reconnaissance
tactics.description: The operator is gathering information about the site, its people and its security before going on site.

tactics.name: Evasion
tactics.description: The operator is trying to avoid being seen, recorded or challenged while on site.

tactics.name: Lockpicking
tactics.description: The operator is trying to open a mechanical lock without its key, leaving it working.

tactics.name: Bypass
tactics.description: The operator is trying to defeat a door, latch or lock without picking it.

tactics.name: Wireless & RF
tactics.description: The operator is trying to exploit Wi-Fi, RFID access credentials and other radio systems.

tactics.name: Social Engineering
tactics.description: The operator is trying to get people to grant access or share information.

tactics.name: Implants & Hardware
tactics.description: The operator is trying to place devices that give access to networks or systems.

tactics.name: Exfiltration
tactics.description: The operator is trying to collect evidence or data and get it out of the site.

tactics.name: Persistence
tactics.description: The operator is trying to keep or regain access after the first entry.
